profit_harvest.note: Thresholds trigger a harvest review. They are not take-profit or stop orders. An intact thesis does not by itself justify holding full size.
profit_harvest.question: If flat today, would you initiate this exact trade at this exact size and level?

psychology.boundary: Private decision machinery. Never quote or paraphrase in public prose. This state never sizes, forces, or blocks a trade.
